title: 2k/3 Romance's Splendid Songs 1: The Wildwood Lad and The Petty Pretty Maid

posts.author: Zeq
posts.body:
Romance's Splendid Songs 1: The Wildwood Lad and The Petty Pretty Maid
Spoiler:
Major Plotlines, Myths and Story
Major Plotline
In the world where skies could fall and oceans could catch fire, heroes and villains alike heard the calls of their destiny. Will they resign to their fate, or will they stand proud and fight on for their destiny of forevermore. For conquest. Or for each other. The story takes place in a planet named Meridien. 3000 years ago, a huge spacecraft, inhabited by sentient species called human race, crashed on Meridien. Those humans, led by several really powerful scientists and warriors, decided to make Meridien their new home, since the Planet Earth, when they left it, was on the brink of total destruction. A new place to call home. The humans renamed themselves as Manu because they want to remind themselves how "manual souls" defeated the Supreme AI, which almost wiped out the entire human race, before the Manuese departed from Earth in search of new home. The Manuese have set up a few civilizations around Meridien. Tensions rise among the nations in Meridien. Will mankind once again bring upon themselves the tragedy?
Myths
"I heard a song that ripples throughout the universes,
A song that permeates through the universes' walls,
A song so lovely but I could not sing to it,
Then I heard a lament across the worlds, "Oh will I ever be reunited with MY BELOVED again" lamented THE DREAD, and hereby from THE ZEAL an echo reached me too, "MY DARLING DREAD where are YOU",
Let the worlds be known, the last war and war for once and for all, I, the Nameless, greatest of the realmwalkers, shall challenge Fates and Destinies, to bring us back to Our Home, The Land that Never Ends."
-The Nameless
Story
Navigate through Bol, a jungleboy, and May, a maid girl in the court of the House of Besterrainhardt, as they both trying to find the questions they've been having about their identities, and purposes of life. One day, May, as tasked, went to the entrance of the forest at the hills behind the Barracks of the Besterrainhardt, accompanied by Shalily, to gather some herbs. May was whistling a song tune, and the sound was picked up by Bol who was sleeping at a few miles away. It moved his instinct. But the song not just moved his instinct, it attracts horrendous beasts that normally would not come any closer. Shalily, the Sergeant who was accompanying her, was having a hard time to fight off the beasts, and May was about to be grabbed and eaten but Bol was quick enough and managed to save her. Although Bol managed to beat some of the beasts and scared the rest away, he was severely injured. May, while worried about Bol condition, fell in love with him at first sight. A few moments later, one of the Besterrainhardt knight captains came into the vicinity after they heard the roars of the beasts. As a thank you, the Lord of Besterrainhardt, Gozzard Deagraeu Besterrainhardt invited Bol to live with them as he thought Bol is only going to waste his life if he continues to live in the forest, because Gozzard felt the potential aura within Bol, and knew that Bol would make a fine Spellblader, a special troop of Besterrainhardt. The House of Besterrainhardt has been doing quests and researches to rediscover Power, Force, and Magic for decades. All their lives they have only be excelling at wielding Guts, with just a lil knowledge of Fabric. Gozzard was told that the knowledge of these five forms of Mana is crucial in surviving the prophesied doomsday scourge.
Spoiler:
Characters
Bol
A nine-years-old boy who lives in the jungle behind the Barracks of Besterrainhardt. His potential in Aurory has been detected by all of Hogzard's 14 Captains and Hogzard himself.
May
A very beautiful 9-years-old girl who was saved from the complete slaughter of her village by Captain Onutref Rizzlebind Shrinke. Shalily took special interest to help raising her in the House. May has an unknown rune on her forehead which, without being known by everyone she knows yet, is actually an entry for her to use Runery that could easily trigger a highly advanced Archivery. But May still doesn't know about it.
Gozzard Deagreu Besterrainhardt
The Lord of Besterrainhardt House. The third best wielder of Guts, in fundamentals, in all of the Kingdom of Emplorea.
Onutref Rizzlebind Shrinke
The best of the 14 Captains of Besterrainhardt, he once devoted all of his being towards swordsmanship that he almost lost his mind. One day, while he suddenly have an urge to kill, he heard an order was given to his co-captains about a slaughter on a village not far away, and he went and dashed straight to that village hoping to satisfy his bloodlust while killing all the slaughterers. When he arrived, he was almost too late, and before, the only one left, May was killed, Onutref mustered to make himself sober and killed all of the assailants. He almost killed May too, but May whistled a song when she cried, because she was calling to her parents who were nowhere to be seen, dead or alive, and that song calmed Onutref. Eversince that day, Onutref and Shalily raise her in the house.
Shalily Soulvea
Onutref's grand daughter. Day by day' she's following her grandpa's steps at bloodlust sword art. But Yam's presence keeps it at bay.
Spoiler:
Other Game Details
Some of the Gameplay Objectives
1. Get May to the Entrance of the Forest
2. Get Bol to May within the time limit
3. Protect May from being killed by the horrendous beasts
4. Talk with the House Physicians
5. Get May and Bol to the Library
6. Talk with a Few Scholars
7. Read some books
8. Go to sparring session with Captain Onutref(both Bol and May)
9. Chase an Intruder of the House

Force, Guts, Magic, Power, Fabric
Methods of Mana:
Willwordry, Forcedrivry, Runery, Handsealry, Commandeery, Daratan, Langit, Lautan, Wizardry, Witchcraft, Soulcraft, Aurory, Dragonry, Chemistry, Archivery, Aspect, Mindzenry, Shapeshiftry, Sourcery, Smithry, Bytology, Tronix, Soulgear, Voidry, Puppetry, Foresightry, Summonstrikery,

Adventure, RPG

Comedy, Romance, Sci fi, Fantasy, Western, Eastern
Game Inspirations taken from:
Final Fantasy 2, 7 ,8 ,9 and Tactics, Fairy Tail, One Piece, Bleach, The Slayers, Dragon Quest The Adventure of Dai, and Doraemon and Doraemon the Movie series
